english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for favouring progress or being politically progressive.
Use this when liberal means progressive, and for politically liberal views or reforms, rather than general open-mindedness.

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 hou2 zeon3 bou6

examples.english: This reform plan is quite liberal and protects many minority groups.
examples.traditional: 呢套改革方案幾進步，保障咗好多少數族裔。
